name: labs/idc-milab__openlh
title: OpenLH liquid handler (uArm Swift Pro)
intro: OpenLH liquid handler (uArm Swift Pro), adapted from idc-milab/openlh. It reads `position_x`, `position_y`, `position_z`, `polar_rotation` and 5 more; sets `base_angle`, `left_angle`, `right_angle`, `hand_angle` and 2 more; runs `move_to_position` and `tool_off`. `move_to_position`: move the tool centre point to a Cartesian position and orientation in a named frame. The endpoint solves inverse kinematics; an unreachable target is rejected before motion. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/idc-milab__openlh --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/idc-milab__openlh --backend fake --mcp
